properties.NAME: Orleans County
properties.CHANGE: Orleans County created by Orleans Territory to "comprehend all that portion of the country lying on both sides of the river Mississippi from the Balize to the beginning of the [ecclesiastical] parishes of St. Bernard & St. Louis."
properties.CITATION: (Orleans Terr. Acts 1804, 1st Leg., 1st sess., ch. 25/p. 144-152; Calhoun, 72-80; Goins and Caldwell, 41)
